conflicts: 253.7 nm isotope shifts: Groh et al. 2025 (MOT) and Gravina et al. 2025 (vapour-cell Lamb dip) agree for 200-198 (-4805.516(36) vs -4805.518(9) MHz) but differ for 202-198 (-10101.224(22) vs -10101.129(11) MHz, 95 kHz, ~4 sigma), 204-198 (-15311.605(36) vs -15311.555(13) MHz) and 196-198 (4179.946(30) vs 4179.923(11) MHz). Both are ~0.5 MHz away from Witkowski et al. 2019 (-4806.28(33), -10101.74(28), -15312.02(30) MHz). Groh kept as the entry (cold atoms), others under alternatives.
253.7 nm absolute frequency of 198Hg: Gravina 2025 1181 555 777 703(5) kHz vs Witkowski 2019 1181555.77854(27) GHz (0.84 MHz higher, ~3 sigma of Witkowski).

6s6p 3P1 lifetime: new frequency-domain value 125.12(79) ns (Gravina et al. 2022) vs the weighted mean of 12 older measurements 118.9(4) ns (Curtis et al. 2001) and 120.0(7) ns (King & Adams); a 5 % disagreement that propagates into A, linewidth and the matrix element (0.4397 e a0 from 125.12 ns vs 0.451 from 118.9 ns; Porsev et al. print 0.4831(8) a.u. for the latter, which does not reproduce in the schema convention). NIST ASD A = 8.40e6 s^-1 corresponds to 119 ns.

Clock-line isotope shift 198-199: 654.480512 MHz from the 2025 lattice-clock measurement of 198Hg vs 699(12) MHz (Petersen 2008) and 662(11) MHz (Schelfhout & McFerran 2022, from Kramida's 198Hg level value); the older numbers rest on interferometric 198Hg data.
199Hg 3P0 hyperfine-quenching rate: measured 0.692(14) s^-1 (Wexler 1980) vs theory 0.76 s^-1 (Porsev 2017) vs 0.013 s^-1 (Hachisu 2008, regarded by Porsev et al. as a calculation error).
Sign of g(3P0) for 201Hg: Porsev et al. Table II prints +0.351058(16)e-3 (experiment) while their abstract prints the theory value as -0.3504(18)e-3.
notes: Conventions. (1) Isotope-shift keys 'a-b' mean nu(a) - nu(b); the 253.7 nm and 313 nm shifts are relative to 198Hg as printed. 199Hg / 201Hg shifts of the 253.7 nm line are hyperfine centres of gravity corrected by Schelfhout & McFerran for the second-order hyperfine interaction. (2) Clock frequencies exceed double precision: use value_Hz_str / unc_Hz. frequency_THz_<A> carries further isotopes. (3) Fields beyond SCHEMA.md: natural_linewidth_*, hyperfine_component_frequencies, frequency_ratios, magic_frequency_MHz, g_factor_<A>Hg (g of the J=0 clock state, x1 not x1e3), top-level 'rydberg' (ionization limit) and 'conflicts'. (4) A_s, linewidth and rme_J_ea0 of the 253.7 nm line are derived here from the measured lifetime (schema convention, single decay channel). (5) Only the 201Hg magnetic hyperfine constants could be sourced; the 199Hg values are missing (see not_found).
